title: The Vibe Coding SaaS Launch Playbook: From Working App to $1K MRR in 30 Days
summary: Building is 20% of the work. Here's the launch GTM playbook for vibe-coded SaaS apps — Reddit, Product Hunt, pricing, first customers, and the road to $1K MRR.
body_markdown: If everyone says yes immediately, you're too cheap. If most people ask "can I get a discount?", you're in the right range. If everyone says no without a conversation, you're too expensive OR your value proposition isn't clear enough. Pricing feedback and messaging feedback often look identical — distinguish them by watching what questions people ask before declining.
